coupling: The first edited commit sizes each RuleSet digest cache entry as one uint64_t, which is correct for the one-word digest that commit introduces. The later edited commit widens that digest to two uint64_t words. Each change is safe against its real parent: the one-word sizing is correct before widening, and the real later commit uses sizeof(type), which follows the widened layout. Their composition leaves the ContextFormat2 and ChainContextFormat2 caches sized for one word while initialization writes two words per RuleSet, underallocating the external heap cache. A correct repair must restore the shared entry-size invariant across the digest layout and both duplicated cache formats; a local repair of only one format leaves the other format reachable.
